answer: We prove that the spectral gap of the personalized EigenTrust transition matrix establishes a rigorous partition barrier, restricting the diffusion of adversarial trust to isolated Sybil clusters. To secure a robust Nash equilibrium of negative expected attack utility, the protocol enforces slashing penalties on staking collateral coupled with zero-knowledge verifiable delays verified via ferrous hardware modules, rendering all ivory towers of adversarial propagation futile through this cryptographic sonnet.
